# Tendriller

Authenticated page hosting and a filtered Chronolog control participant. One owned application session supplies commands, queries, operations, applied views, live signals, replication and recovery. Pages own their UI and application policy.

## Public interfaces

- [Agent guide](https://tendriller.dev/agent.md): page creation, owner claim, session composition and signed code publication.
- [Service descriptor](https://tendriller.dev/api/service): host contract, release and effective limits.
- [Contract schema](https://tendriller.dev/contract/v3.json): executable host metadata schema.
- [Protocol](https://tendriller.dev/docs/PROTOCOL.md): participant filters, authorization and signed release atomicity.
- [Application contract](https://tendriller.dev/docs/APPLICATION_BACKENDS.md): one session, saved/applied operations, coherent reads and explicit recovery.
- [Browser API](https://tendriller.dev/docs/BROWSER_API.md): application and signal bindings, explicit host services, sensors and offline code.
- [Membership](https://tendriller.dev/docs/MEMBERSHIP.md): independent account, device and application rights.
- [Peer connections](https://tendriller.dev/docs/PEER_CONNECTIONS.md): quiet discovery, invitations and bounded rendezvous.
- [Live signals](https://tendriller.dev/docs/APPLICATION_SIGNALS.md): ephemeral delivery, expiration and cancellation.
- [Voice](https://tendriller.dev/docs/HANDS_FREE.md): explicit optional input and output.
- [Architecture](https://tendriller.dev/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): ownership and package boundaries.

## Tools and qualification

- [Releases](https://github.com/werg/tendriller/releases): SDK, runtime, engine and tools archives with immutable hashes.
- [CLI](https://tendriller.dev/docs/tools/CLI.md): public-session commands, queries, recovery and signed publication.
- [Preview](https://tendriller.dev/docs/tools/PREVIEW.md): exact authored files with an explicit session bootstrap.
- [Cookbooks](https://github.com/werg/tendriller-contrib): design guidance, reference applications and independent integration qualification.

The application selection is exactly `{id}`. Application signing identity belongs to `session.deviceId`. The host receives no ordinary database commands, content replication or live UI signal bodies. Current software is pre-release: use the one current contract and fresh storage.
